column1: # Cathay's FX-hedging pie, for the decks that print it as an IMAGE.
# From 1Q24 to 1Q26 Cathay's "FX asset hedging structure" pie carries no text
# layer: the slide's own words are extractable, the three slice percentages are
# not. Every other quarter parses from the text and is NOT listed here — this
# file covers only the pages where the number exists solely as pixels.
# Each row was read off the rendered page named in source_deck/source_page,
# fetched from the company's own IR site (the URL is in data/cathay_deck_fx.csv
# against the same deck_date). The reading is checkable three ways and all
# three hold on every row below:
#   cs_ndf + proxy_open + fvoci = 100
#   fx_risk + fx_policy         = 100
#   cs_ndf x fx_risk / 100      = the sell-side workbook's traditional hedge %
# The third is the strongest: 1Q24 57 x 0.69 = 39.33 against their 39.3, 1H24
# workbook stops at 2Q25; FY25 and 1Q26 stand on the first two checks alone.
# fx_assets_ntd_tn is the slide's own "FX asset NT$X.XXTN", which reconciles to
# the Insurance Bureau's 國外投資 for the same firm-date to three significant
# The parser prints a warning naming any image-only pie page that has no row
# here, so a future quarter cannot go missing silently.
